name: Kurotsuki Saaya
source: Tachibana's classmate, who is usually seen holding her stuffed bear. Saya might look childish on the outside with her stuffed bear, but she has a serious case of chuunibyou where she claims she can see and talk to spirits. Saaya is also really interested in black magic and everything related to this theme.
